title: Northgate Tire Center Flat Repair Charge — Member Services Console Reference
content:
# Flat repair charge on a Northgate Tire Center package

**What the rule settles.** The flat repair charge is the charge for the most recent flat repair entry recorded on a Northgate Tire Center package: one flat repair charge (`flat_repair`) for the repaired wheel, dated on that repair's work order.

**Observable effect.** Once booked, the package shows one flat repair charge entry for the repaired wheel, dated on the repair work order; the package's balance of Tire Center charges rises by the amount. Nothing else on the package changes.

## The booking tool: `post_flat_repair_charge_9a2582c0`

**Capability.** `post_flat_repair_charge_9a2582c0` posts the charge for plugging and patching a repairable puncture in one tire of a Tire Center installation package, dated on the repair's work order. One call adds exactly one flat repair charge entry for that wheel.

**How it is invoked.** This is a member services tool held on the agent side. It is first unlocked with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then called with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, under the name `post_flat_repair_charge_9a2582c0`.

**Parameters.**

- `tire_service_id` — the installation package reference number of the tire set, as read from the Tire Center package lookup.
- `tire_position` — the wheel whose tire was repaired, exactly one of: `left_front` (the repaired tire is on the driver-side front wheel), `right_front` (passenger-side front wheel), `left_rear` (driver-side rear wheel), `right_rear` (passenger-side rear wheel), `spare` (the repaired tire is the full-size spare), `all_positions` (one charge covering repairs on every wheel of the set at once).
- `service_date` — the date of the repair work order, written YYYY-MM-DD as on that work order entry, with no time and no time zone.
- `odometer_miles` — the vehicle odometer on that repair work order, a whole number of miles with no separators or decimals.
- `amount` — the charge to book, in USD with 2 decimal places, zero or more; the value is passed already worked out to the cent and is booked as given.

| Parameter | Format |
|---|---|
| `tire_service_id` | package reference number (text) |
| `tire_position` | one of the six wheel values |
| `service_date` | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `odometer_miles` | whole miles |
| `amount` | USD, 2 decimal places, zero or more |

**Return.** A receipt rendered as text with: `tire_event_id`, the reference number of the new charge entry; `tire_service_id`, the package charged; `charge_component`, always `flat_repair`; `tire_position`, the wheel charged; `service_date`, the work order date (YYYY-MM-DD); `amount`, the charge in USD with 2 decimal places; and `status`, "booked" when the entry was added. A receipt with status "booked" means the charge now stands on the package.
